from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the filing")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the filing covers, e.g., 'March 31, 2025'")
    
    # Profitability inputs
    net_income_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net income or loss value reported")
    net_income_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit of the net income value, e.g., 'million', 'thousand'")
    net_sales_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net sales or revenue value reported")
    net_sales_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit of the net sales value, e.g., 'million', 'thousand'")
    
    # Reinvestment inputs
    total_assets_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Total assets value reported")
    total_assets_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit of total assets, e.g., 'million', 'thousand'")
    investing_cash_flow_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net cash used or provided in investing activities (signed value)")
    investing_cash_flow_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit of investing cash flow")
    
    # Direct Capital Expenditure (if explicitly stated for use as CapEx approximation)
    direct_capex_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Direct capital expenditure value if available (e.g. additions to PPE)")
    direct_capex_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit of direct capital expenditure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyData] = Field(description="List of company financial records extracted from the provided documents")
